reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing selection helpers (getCategoryIdsExcludedFromMonthWideActions, getCategoriesForMonthWideAverage/forEachMonthWideCategory) and a shared MonthWideActionArgs type rather than re-querying per action.

duplication.why: The hidden toggle is written twice, once as an exclusion clause and once as its negated inclusion clause, because the two pre-existing selection functions were extended in parallel instead of unified.

placement.why: Selection changes stay in the selection helpers of budget/actions.ts; the actions only pass the flag.

scope.why: Only the flag, its plumbing, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Interpolated SQL fragments in two mirrored queries must be kept in sync by hand; a positional boolean on forEachMonthWideCategory is slightly opaque.

disguised_duplication.where: budget/actions.ts: hiddenClause in getCategoryIdsExcludedFromMonthWideActions ('c.hidden = 1 OR g.hidden = 1 OR') and its negated twin in getCategoriesForMonthWideAverage ('AND c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0')
